bogaerts_2017.study_type: In vivo ultrasound speckle-tracking during submaximal isometric plantarflexion
bogaerts_2017.audit_ruling: Bogaerts 2017 confirms in vivo displacement non-uniformity (+23.1% deep layer shear), but CANNOT serve as empirical S-N fatigue curve source.

schechtman_wren_benchmarks.specimen_types: Ex vivo human extensor digitorum longus & Achilles tendon specimens tested to cyclic mechanical failure

semi_log_basquin_model.note: Yields exact 0.1333 retention ratio (-86.67% loss) reported in Cycle 19 RESULTS.json.

power_law_wohler_model.discrepancy_explanation: Cycle 19 prose cited B = 8.45 while reporting -86.7% drop. For power law with B = 8.45, 1.20^(-8.45) = 0.2144 (-78.56% drop). The -86.7% drop came from the semi-log Basquin model with slope k = -10.808. Both models are mathematically valid under their respective formulations, but their parameters cannot be conflated.

stress_and_hypertrophy_forensic_correcti.flawed_34_78_mpa_reconstruction: Cycle 19 report inadvertently stated adapted stress as 34.78 MPa. Forensic reconstruction proves 34.78 MPa was obtained by dividing BASELINE unaugmented force (4000 N) by 115 mm2 (4000 / 115 = 34.78 MPa). For augmented force (4800 N) and 15% hypertrophy (119.6 mm2), the exact physical stress is 4800 / 119.6 = 40.13 MPa. At 40.13 MPa with 10% UTS (104.5 MPa), stress ratio S = 0.3840 (lower than baseline S0 = 0.4048), fully restoring fatigue retention to 1.678x.

case_2b_modulus_stiffening_multiaxial_au.enthesis_shear_stress_risk: HIGH: Tendon stiffening without bone-tendon compliance grading increases shear stress concentration at unmineralized fibrocartilage interface.
case_2b_modulus_stiffening_multiaxial_au.scientific_verdict: NEG-0057 is valid strictly under force-controlled uniaxial tension. Under strain-controlled, viscoelastic, or catapult locomotion, modulus increases are functionally detrimental rather than neutral.

iso_durability_adaptation_boundary.biological_feasibility: Human progressive resistance exercise can induce 5-15% tendon hypertrophy and 5-12% UTS increase over 12-24 weeks, making fatigue restoration physiologically feasible.
